category_title: Boys who have been victims of bullying and project parental advice into social interactions
student_description: This student has a history of being bullied and strongly identifies with the victim role, believing victims are entirely isolated and must suppress their anger. He tends to parrot parental advice rather than generate his own coping strategies. He uniquely requires emotionally safe, prop-based role-play to express himself indirectly, alongside long-term support to build consequential thinking and trust in external support systems.

criteria.rationale: The student relies on rigid beliefs (e.g., 'suppressing anger is the only way', 'apologizing shows weakness') and needs help evaluating the actual social outcomes of these behaviors.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must include strategies to help the student analyze the outcomes and consequences of different social actions or conflict resolutions.

criteria.rationale: The student firmly believes victims have no support and cannot talk to anyone, so he needs sustained help recognizing and building meaningful relationships outside the bully-victim dynamic.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must incorporate steps to build the student's meaningful relationships with peers, educators, or family members to prove that external support exists.

criteria.criterion_name: Continuous Assurance of Confidentiality and Autonomy
criteria.rationale: Trust is fragile for a student who feels isolated and victimized; explicit guarantees of privacy and voluntary participation are required to keep him engaged.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must explicitly include regular individual check-ins that reinforce confidentiality and the student's ongoing consent to participate.
